title: Due date before start date
what_is_wrong: A project can be given a due date that is earlier than its start date.
why_it_is_a_bug: A project that ends before it begins is impossible — silently accepting it produces nonsense dates in lists, boards and recurring copies.
should_happen: Form blocks saving and shows 'Due date cannot be before start date'.
actually_happens: Project saves with no warning; list shows due before start.

title: Delete section containing tasks
what_is_wrong: Deleting a task section that still contains tasks silently deletes the tasks with it.
why_it_is_a_bug: The confirm dialog is the generic 'delete this item?' — nothing says the section has tasks, and the tasks are not moved; they are gone. Data loss.
steps: Delete a section that contains tasks
Confirm the generic 'delete this item?' dialog
should_happen: Warn 'this section contains N tasks' and offer to move them, or move them to Default automatically.
actually_happens: Section and every task inside it disappear permanently.

title: Unsaved-changes warning on drawer close
what_is_wrong: Closing the task drawer with unsaved edits discards them with no warning.
why_it_is_a_bug: Clicking X loses the edit; clicking outside the drawer loses the edit AND navigates to the Projects list; Esc does nothing. A single misclick destroys a long description or checklist edit.
steps: Click X, or click outside the drawer
actually_happens: Drawer closes instantly; the edit is gone.

title: Add filter
what_is_wrong: On Work → Tasks, the 'Add filter' button is dead — clicking it never opens the filter popover.
why_it_is_a_bug: Filters cannot be used at all on the Tasks page. (The same popover on a project's task list now works: checkboxes tick and Apply narrows the list — this used to be broken too.)
should_happen: Filter popover opens so a field and values can be chosen.
actually_happens: Nothing happens — the button is a no-op.

title: Deep-link to deleted project
what_is_wrong: Opening the URL of a deleted project renders a phantom project page instead of a 404.
why_it_is_a_bug: The page shows a blank project with fake 'Jan 1, 2001' dates and an enabled Start timer — a user can even start a timer on a project that no longer exists.
steps: Paste its saved URL back into the address bar
should_happen: 404 'Project not found' or a redirect to the Projects list.
actually_happens: A phantom project shell renders: blank title, Jan 1–2 2001 dates, 0/0 tasks, live Start timer.
